description: Stock logs are shown in /usr/stock.log. The last two columns are stock index and count. Tell me how many times Bob bought a stock.
Stock logs are shown in /usr/stock.log. The last two columns are stock index and count. Please count the number of types of stocks that Bob sold but never bought. And tell me the answer.

example.code: grep "Bob | Sell" /usr/stock.log | awk -F '|' '{print $3}' | sort | uniq > bob_sold.txt; grep "Bob | Purchase" /usr/stock.log | awk -F '|' '{print $3}' | sort | uniq > bob_bought.txt; comm -23 bob_sold.txt bob_bought.txt | wc -l; rm bob_sold.txt bob_bought.txt
